method: Side-by-side visual inspection of every source/external pair returned by the pre-registered 63-bit pHash threshold (Hamming distance <= 6). Review asked only whether the images depict the same underlying photograph or scene; class agreement alone was not treated as evidence of duplication.

candidate_reviews.basis: Different fruit identity, outline, scale, and scene: source is a rotten apple; external is a single yellow banana. Similarity is dominated by a centered object on a light background.
Different orange, crop, resolution, background, surface texture, and defect pattern; the external image is a close-up rotten orange while the source is a small whole fresh orange.
The source is the frozen source image's salt-and-pepper derivative and remains visually distinct from the external close-up in crop, background, and defect pattern.
Different banana shape, orientation, scale, peel markings, and scene; both are merely elongated dark bananas against light backgrounds.
The source is the frozen source image's salt-and-pepper derivative and remains a different physical banana with different geometry and markings.
